notes.title: News about the project!
notes.content:
It has been a while since we last brought any news about the game, and first we'd like to apologize for that!

To solve some doubts and questions, let's use this post to talk a little about our team and the current and future state of the project!

We are an indie studio located in Brazil, we have a small team and a giant project!!!

Dante's Hotel is a game that means a lot to us, and we are working day and night to deliver an amazing game to you! We want to deliver a game that will bring true emotions to those who play... The original release date was scheduled for 2022, but the project turned out to be much more complex than planned, which made us choose between releasing a game with fewer features and smaller size or postpone the release and put the features we want to see in the project. We decided to postpone the release and put everything we planned into the game!

We don't have a new release date, but as soon as that information is decided, we will report here!

We have worked and evolved the game a lot since the screenshots and trailers of the initial posts, and we would like to share a little bit of this evolution with you...
